Hi hi!

Best wishes,
Stijn form Frog Vibes

notes.title: Collectables will now be stored in your save data!
notes.notes:
Hi hi!

After some consideration, we added a saving feature to the game. Collectibles will now be saved once you find them. Items won't be, however.

We're now also keeping track of whether you've defeated the warlock, however, this is not yet displayed. We're working on a broader in-game achievement system, as well as connecting these things to Steam achievements.

More updates are on the way, including some bigger content updates. Be sure to join our discord if you'd like to pitch your ideas for future updates.

See ya!
Stijn

notes.title: A whole new area to explore!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Hope you've been enjoying Knight Trail so far.
We've been meaning to expand the game, and now we're finally, officially adding a whole new continent!

To reach it travel all the way north. You'll find a small house inhabited by dwarfs. They'll help you get to the northen continent, as long as you have enough gold.

In other news, we added an in-game map! Check it by pressing "N" or "Select".
In other, other news, you might have noticed that we brought the game over to our main studio, Frog Vibes!

We're hoping to make more content updates in the future, so stay tuned!

Fare de well!
Team Frog Vibes
